senses.gloss: m. ch. = h.זָקָן , beard, bearded chin, hair-growth.
units: <cite ref="Onkelos Leviticus 13:29">Targ. Lev. XIII, 29</cite> sq.; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Bava Batra 58a:8">B. Bath. 58ᵃ</cite> <he>תפשיה בדִיקְנֵיה</he> seized him by his beard.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 72">Gen. R. s. 72</cite> (prov.) <he>הניאת לסבי מן דִּיקְנִי</he> thou pleasest my grandfather (with hair) from my beard, i.e. you wish to be liberal at other people’s expense; (<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 129:2">Yalk. Gen. 129</cite> <he>הבאת לפני מן דאקני</he>, corr. acc.).
<cite ref="Nazir 39a">Naz. 39ᵃ</cite> bot. [read:] <he>כד צבעי סביא דִיקְנֵהוֹן</he> when old men dye their beards.

<cite ref="Bava Metzia 60b:5">B. Mets. 60ᵇ</cite> <he>צבעיה לרישיה ולדִיקְנֵיה</he> he dyed the hair of his head and beard; <cite ref="Bava Metzia 60b:6">ib.</cite> <he>חווריה … ולד׳</he> he washed it white again; a. fr.—Pl. <he>דִּקְנִין</he>, <cite ref="D00763"><he>דִּי׳</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Leviticus 19:27">Targ. Y. Lev. XIX, 27</cite>; a. e.—
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 39a">B. Mets. 39ᵃ</cite>, v. <cite ref="D01013">next w.</cite>
